title: ContextObjects RPS Strategy Configuration
description: Storage and query configuration for the ContextObjects Reversed-Path Search dual-collection strategy. Controls collection names, document field shorthands, and AQL query limits.

database_name.title: Target Database
database_name.description: MongoDB database where context_objects and context_objects_search will be created. Must match the database in the connection binding.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: MongoDB collection names for the dual-collection layout.

objects.title: Primary Collection
objects.description: Stores full ContextObject instances with the complete content-node tree (cn[]).

name.title: Collection Name
name.description: Name of the primary collection. Defaults to context_objects.

search.title: Search Collection
search.description: Stores denormalised path→value pairs (sn[]) for fast AQL queries across large populations.

name.title: Collection Name
name.description: Name of the search collection. Defaults to context_objects_search.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: When false, the search collection is not maintained. AQL queries will fail if disabled.

fields.title: Document Field Names
fields.description: Shorthand field names used in stored documents. Change these only when integrating with an existing collection that uses different names.

object_type.title: objectType Field
object_type.description: Top-level field that stores the semantic model identifier (objectType). Default: ot

record_id.title: recordId Field
record_id.description: Top-level field that stores the unique instance identifier, also used as _id. Default: rid

version.title: version Field
version.description: Top-level field that stores the instance version string. Default: ver

content_nodes.title: Content Nodes Array
content_nodes.description: Field name for the content-node array in the primary collection. Default: cn

search_nodes.title: Search Nodes Array
search_nodes.description: Field name for the search-node array in the search collection. Default: sn

meta.title: Meta Field
meta.description: Field name for the instance metadata object. Default: meta

node_fields.title: Node-Level Field Names
node_fields.description: Shorthand field names used inside each node entry in cn[] and sn[] arrays.

path.title: Path Field
path.description: Field name for the full node path inside each cn/sn entry, e.g. /data[co0001][co0002]. Default: p

node_id.title: Node ID Field
node_id.description: Field name for the node identifier inside each cn/sn entry, e.g. co0001. Default: nid

ancestors.title: Ancestors Field
ancestors.description: Field name for the ancestor node-ID array in cn[] entries. Default: anc

value.title: Value Field
value.description: Field name for the leaf value inside each cn/sn entry. Default: v

data_type.title: Data Type Field
data_type.description: Field name for the data type shorthand inside each cn/sn entry (string, integer, coded_text, etc.). Default: dt

default_limit.title: Default Limit
default_limit.description: Default number of results returned when LIMIT is not specified in AQL. Default: 100

max_limit.title: Maximum Limit
max_limit.description: Hard cap on result set size regardless of LIMIT clause. Default: 1000
